en.summary: South Korean equestrian rider Nam Dong-heon won gold in individual dressage at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 75.190 points and claiming South Korea's first title in the event in 12 years.

stories.title: S. Korea Wins Equestrian Dressage Gold After 12 Years

en.title: S. Korea Wins Equestrian Dressage Gold After 12 Years
en.summary: South Korean equestrian rider Nam Dong-heon won the gold medal in individual dressage at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 75.190 points with his horse Leonidas and reclaiming the title for South Korea after 12 years.

en.summary: South Korea won three gold medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday, defeating Japan in fencing, esports, and basketball. The men's sabre fencing team secured victory with a narrow 45-44 final margin.
